title: Prelude NZ — Instrument Rental
description: Search and rent musical instruments in New Zealand. Pricing, teachers, and FAQs.
summary: Search and rent musical instruments in New Zealand. Pricing, teachers, and FAQs.
offersHint: Search and rent musical instruments in New Zealand. Pricing, teachers, and FAQs. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://prelude.co.nz/mcp/prelude

toolsPreview.name: search-instruments-tool
toolsPreview.description: Search instruments available for rental at Prelude NZ. Filter by instrument category (e.g. violin, flute) or family (e.g. strings, woodwind). Returns name, category, tier, pricing, availability, and a link to the instrument page.

toolsPreview.name: get-pricing-tool
toolsPreview.description: Get rental pricing plans for a specific instrument at Prelude NZ. Returns all available plan options with monthly and total prices.

toolsPreview.name: search-teachers-tool
toolsPreview.description: Find music teachers in New Zealand listed on Prelude. Filter by instrument and region. Returns teacher names, regions, instruments taught, and a link to their profile page for full details and contact.

toolsPreview.name: get-faqs-tool
toolsPreview.description: Get frequently asked questions about renting instruments from Prelude NZ. Covers how rental works, plans, pricing, delivery, returns, and more.
